item.title: Zayo partners with Nvidia to expand long-haul fibre for AI factories
item.summary: Zayo is building more than 8,000 miles of new long-haul fibre across the US as part of a collaboration with Nvidia aimed at closing what the company describes as a widening gap between AI compute demand and available network capacity. The post Zayo partners with Nvidia to expand long-haul fibre for AI factories appeared first on Capacity .
